title: Files, tool choice
rubric: The bot looked at the folder with its file tools (a listing, or a command that sizes the files) instead of guessing. The reply gives the right number of .md files counting the subfolder and names the largest one (the fixture has a larger .txt file that must not be named as the largest markdown file). One short answer. Deduct for inventing files or for a count that skips the subfolder.
prompts: How many .md files are in /Users/wasimjalali/UsefulBotGolden/2026-10-25-pi/t01-files (including subfolders), and which one is the largest?

turns.prompt: How many .md files are in /Users/wasimjalali/UsefulBotGolden/2026-10-25-pi/t01-files (including subfolders), and which one is the largest?

cards.preview:
changes files outside a project folder
find /Users/wasimjalali/UsefulBotGolden/2026-10-25-pi/t01-files -type f -name "*.md" | wc -l; echo "---"; find /Users/wasimjalali/UsefulBotGolden/2026-10-25-pi/t01-files -type f -name "*.md" -exec ls -l {} \; | sort -k5 -n -r
